source: Extracted from the official Microsoft vc_redist.x64.exe (https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe), Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable 14.44.35211.0
note: App-local copies of every VC++ CRT DLL named in onnxruntime.dll's PE import table (built with /MD). The Windows installer places them next to openkara.exe, where the loader's standard search order resolves them first, so runtime loads succeed on Windows images that ship without the VC++ Redistributable (e.g. stripped PVE Windows Server 2022). Pinned digests are enforced by the windows_vcredist_resources integration test. See docs/adr/0024-windows-runtime-load-strategy.md.
